name: Landfall
description: The transport went down short of Ashgate. Grab the flight recorder, fight up the high street, through the checkpoint and the square, and make the helipad before the evacuation bird leaves.
briefing: Your transport went down on the approach to Ashgate. The pilot did not make it.
Recover the flight recorder from the wreck: it holds the routes for every evacuation run out of the city.
Fight up the high street, get the checkpoint gate open and clear the square. The bird lifts off the helipad in twelve minutes, with or without you.
debrief: Bird is lifting. Good work, squad. That recorder is going to get a lot of people out.

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: Rook, this is Command. Your bird is down short of Ashgate. Pull the flight recorder out of that wreck and get to the street gate before they smell the fuel.
radio.done: Recorder secured. The street gate is open: move.

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: The high street runs straight to the army checkpoint. The pharmacy on the right still has supplies if you can get the door down.
radio.done: Checkpoint ahead. Its gate is dead.

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: Gate's on its own generator. Start it up and keep them off it.
radio.done: Generator's up! The gate motor's taking it: hold that checkpoint.

objectives.label: Hold the checkpoint while the gate opens

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: Gate's grinding open. Every one of them heard that. Hold!
radio.done: You're through. The square is crawling.

objectives.label: Burn the nests in the square

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: Those growths in the square are breeding them. Burn all three or the pad will never be clear.
radio.done: Nests are down. Something big is coming out of the rubble.

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: Brute in the square! Stay off its line and keep shooting.
radio.done: It's down. The pad gate is open.

objectives.label: Hold the pad until the bird lands

radio.speaker: Pilot
radio.start: Raven Two, forty seconds out. Keep that pad clear for me.

radio.speaker: Pilot
radio.start: Wheels down! Everybody on, now!

name: Rail Yard
description: The convoy needs the rail yard's points thrown to get through. Find the switch keys in the wrecked station, burn the nests in the container stacks, get the crane gate open, throw the points in the signal box and hold the road until the trucks arrive.
briefing: A freight train jumped the rails at the edge of Ashgate and the yard behind it is crawling.
The convoy can only get through on the north road, and only if the points are thrown in the signal box. The stationmaster's switch keys are somewhere in the wreck of the station.
Move north section by section; the gates lock behind you. The convoy waits eleven minutes.
debrief: Points thrown, convoy through. That yard was the last way out of the east side.

radio.speaker: Convoy
radio.start: Rook, Convoy. The stationmaster kept the switch keys in his office, west side of the platform. Get them and bring them to the yard gate.
radio.done: Keys on the gate. It's open: into the stacks.

objectives.label: Burn the nests in the stacks

radio.speaker: Convoy
radio.start: Three nests between the containers. Burn them or they'll fill the yard behind you.
radio.done: Nests are down. The north gate runs off the crane generator.

radio.speaker: Convoy
radio.start: Generator's by the north gate. Start it up and keep them off it while it runs up.

objectives.label: Hold the gate while it grinds open

radio.speaker: Convoy
radio.start: Gate's moving. Hold the ground in front of it!
radio.done: Through! The signal box is on the east side.

objectives.label: Throw the points in the signal box

radio.speaker: Convoy
radio.start: Signal box, east side. Get the door open and throw the points from the panel.
radio.done: Points thrown. Something big just woke up in the turntable pit.

radio.speaker: Convoy
radio.start: Brute coming out of the turntable! Keep moving and keep shooting.
radio.done: It's down. Road gate's open.

objectives.label: Hold the road until the convoy arrives

radio.speaker: Convoy
radio.start: Thirty-five seconds out. Keep that road clear!

radio.speaker: Convoy
radio.start: Trucks are here. Everybody on!

name: Blackout
description: Ashgate's power plant went dark. Get through the fence on the backup generator, restart the three generators in the transformer yard and keep the transformer alive, reroute the grid from the control room, and get out past the cooling towers.
briefing: The plant that keeps Ashgate's lights and pumps running has gone dark, and the dark is where they nest.
The fence gate runs off a backup generator. Inside, three generators feed the transformer and the yard's turrets: restart them, then keep the transformer standing while the grid comes back.
The grid is rerouted from the control room. The exit road is past the cooling towers. Thirteen minutes before the district's reserve runs out.
debrief: Grid's back. Half of Ashgate just got its lights on. Nice work.

radio.speaker: Engineer
radio.start: Plant's dead and so is half the city. Get me to the fence.

radio.speaker: Engineer
radio.start: The gate runs off the backup generator, west of it. Start it and hold them off while it runs up.
radio.done: Gate's open. Into the yard.

radio.speaker: Engineer
radio.start: Three generators: west, east and north. Each one wakes a turret.
radio.done: All three running. The transformer's coming up.

objectives.label: Burn the nests in the yard

radio.speaker: Engineer
radio.start: Two nests in the corners. Burn them before we bring the transformer up.

radio.speaker: Engineer
radio.start: Seventy seconds while it charges. Everything in the yard is coming for it!
radio.done: Transformer's live. The control building is open.

objectives.label: Reroute the grid from the control room

radio.speaker: Engineer
radio.start: Control room, north-east corner of the building. Open the door and work the panel.
radio.done: Grid rerouted. Something's moving in the turbine hall.

objectives.label: Put down the Brute in the turbine hall

radio.speaker: Scout
radio.start: Brute in the turbine hall, between you and the north door!
radio.done: It's down. The tower gate is open.

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: Road's clear past the towers. Everyone out before the whole district wakes up.

name: Holdouts
description: Two families are holed up on Elm Close, a street the residents barricaded themselves. Clear the main road, raise them on the residents' radio, burn the nests in the back gardens, and walk everyone to the school minibus before the roads close.

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: The main road's crawling. Clear it and the residents will open their gate.

objectives.label: Raise the families on the residents' radio

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: Their radio's in the first house on the left. Get on it and find out where they are.
radio.done: Got them. One family on the north side, one on the south.

objectives.label: Burn the nests in the back gardens

radio.speaker: Scout
radio.start: Two nests in the back gardens, right behind their houses. Burn them or you'll never get them out.
radio.done: Nests are gone. Go get them.

objectives.label: Walk the families to the far barricade

radio.speaker: Survivor
radio.start: Is someone there? Please, they're in the garden, we can hear them...
radio.done: We're at the gate. Thank you, thank you.

objectives.label: Put down the Brute in the schoolyard

radio.speaker: Scout
radio.start: Gate's open, and there's a Brute in the schoolyard, right by the minibus. It has to go.

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: Minibus is running. Everyone aboard, now!

objectives.label: Optional: crack the gun shop's safe

briefing: Elm Close barricaded itself in when Ashgate fell. Two families are still in their houses; their radio went quiet this morning.
Clear the main road so they open the gate, raise them on the residents' radio in the first house, burn the nests in the back gardens and walk them out through the far barricade to the school.
The minibus at the school is the way out. The roads close in fifteen minutes. Nobody gets left behind.
debrief: Minibus is rolling with both families on it. Elm Close held out. So did you.

name: Breakout
description: Hold the motor pool while the last evacuation column loads up, wake its turrets, break the waves and the Brutes, then break out through the north gate.

radio.speaker: Sergeant
radio.start: Column's loading. Hold the centre of the yard and draw them onto us.

objectives.label: Start the generators for the turrets

radio.speaker: Sergeant
radio.start: Generators west and east. Get them running and the turrets wake up.
radio.done: Turrets are up. Here comes the next lot.

radio.speaker: Sergeant
radio.start: Second wave, and they brought screamers. Kill the screamers first!

radio.speaker: Scout
radio.start: Two Brutes coming through the south fence!
radio.done: Both down. Unbelievable.

radio.speaker: Sergeant
radio.start: Last trucks are loading. Ninety more seconds!
radio.done: Column's out. North gate's open!

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: Road north is yours. Everyone out, now!

briefing: The last evacuation column is loading up in the army motor pool, and the noise is pulling in everything for miles.
Hold the centre while they load. Two generators can wake the yard's turrets. Brutes have been seen in the area.
When the last truck is gone the north gate opens. Fourteen minutes, then the roads are theirs.
debrief: Column's clear and the motor pool is theirs now. That was the hardest stand yet.

name: Airlift
description: A transport is down on Harrow's airfield with its ramps broken. Hold the cargo bay while the crew fixes them, keep the hydraulics alive, then clear the apron for take-off.
briefing: The last transport out of Harrow put down on the airfield with both ramps jammed open, and every dead thing for miles heard it land.
Hold the cargo bay while the crew works. They'll open the side bays and the jumpseat room as they get to them; there's kit in both.
Something big is coming across the apron. It doesn't get near the plane.
debrief: Wheels up. Nobody left on the tarmac.

radio.speaker: Pilot
radio.start: Both ramps are jammed open. Hold the bay while my crew gets to work!
radio.done: First ramp's moving. Need power for the rest.

objectives.label: Start the power unit on the apron

radio.speaker: Pilot
radio.start: The ground power unit's on the apron, off the tail. Get it running and the ramp turrets wake up.
radio.done: Power's on. Side bays are open, grab what's in them.

radio.speaker: Pilot
radio.start: Hydraulics are between the ramps and they're going for them. Eighty seconds!
radio.done: Ramps are up. Jumpseat room's open, there's a med kit in there.

radio.speaker: Tower
radio.start: Big one on the apron, right where you need to roll. Put it down!
radio.done: Apron's clear.

objectives.label: Hold on while the engines spin up

radio.speaker: Pilot
radio.start: Engines spinning up. Forty seconds!

radio.speaker: Pilot
radio.start: Nose up in forty. Get in the bay!

name: Hive
description: The supermarket on the ring road has become a nest. Burn the pods in the car park, the nests among the aisles, then the egg in the loading yard and whatever hatches from it.
briefing: The supermarket on Harrow's ring road went quiet a week ago. Now it breathes.
Pods all over the car park, nests in the aisles. Burn every one: while they stand, the dead keep coming.
Behind the shop, in the loading yard, there's an egg the size of a van. Burn its brood, then whatever comes out.
debrief: Hive's burnt out. Harrow's ring road is ours again.

objectives.label: Burn the pods in the car park

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: Pods all over the car park. Burn them, then we'll get the doors open.
radio.done: Car park's clear. The front doors are giving way.

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: Get inside before the doors fall on you.

objectives.label: Burn the nests among the aisles

radio.speaker: Scout
radio.start: Four nests: the west aisles, the east aisles, behind the deli and in the freezers.
radio.done: That's the last one. Loading doors are open.

objectives.label: Burn the brood round the egg

radio.speaker: Scout
radio.start: Three smaller eggs round the big one. Burn them first.
radio.done: Brood's gone. The big one's cracking open!

radio.speaker: Scout
radio.start: It's out! Put it down!
radio.done: It's dead. Van's on its way.

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: Van's at the yard gate. Everyone on!

name: Lifeline
description: Harrow General has lost power and its patients are on borrowed batteries. Clear the atrium, then work down each corridor to its switch room, one after another.
briefing: Harrow General is still holding: its doors keep the dead out, but the power's gone and the backup batteries won't last.
Four switch rooms, each at the end of its own corridor off the atrium. The corridors open one at a time, once the atrium is clear.
The last team in didn't make it past the atrium. Their kit is still on the floor.
debrief: Lights are on in Harrow General. Everyone on the wards made it.

radio.speaker: Doctor
radio.start: They're coming out of the walls in the atrium. Clear it and the first corridor opens.
radio.done: Corridor Alpha's open, north side.

radio.speaker: Doctor
radio.start: Alpha's at the far end, past the ward. Throw it and come back.
radio.done: Alpha's in. They're in the atrium again.

radio.speaker: Doctor
radio.start: Clear them out and I'll open Bravo, east side.
radio.done: Bravo's open.

radio.speaker: Doctor
radio.start: Bravo's room is up the corridor and round the corner.
radio.done: Two down. Here they come again.

radio.speaker: Doctor
radio.start: Screamers in that lot! Kill them first. Charlie opens after, south side.
radio.done: Charlie's open.

radio.speaker: Doctor
radio.start: Charlie's down the long corridor, the far west room. There's a store behind the boxes in the east ward.
radio.done: Three. One to go.

objectives.label: Clear the atrium one more time

radio.speaker: Doctor
radio.start: Last lot before Delta. North-east door.
radio.done: Delta's open.

radio.speaker: Doctor
radio.start: Delta's at the end of the north-east corridor.
radio.done: Power's back! Something big just walked into the atrium...

objectives.label: Put down the Brutes in the atrium

radio.speaker: Doctor
radio.start: Two of them in the atrium! Keep them off the wards!
radio.done: Both down. Ambulance bay, now.

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: Ambulance bay, everyone. Forty-five seconds.

name: The Minister
description: The minister is shut in the safe room of a mansion on Harrow's hill. Clear the house, override the lock, walk the minister to the helipad on the lawn and hold it until the chopper lands.
briefing: The minister for reconstruction locked themselves in the safe room of their house on the hill when the dead came up the drive.
The house is a maze of rooms and dead ends. Clear it, override the safe room lock from the kitchen, and walk the minister out to the helipad.
There's a generator in the garden that wakes the helipad's turrets. Nine minutes before the chopper has to turn back.
debrief: Minister's aboard. They'll be thanking you on the radio for a week.

radio.speaker: Minister
radio.start: Hello? Is someone out there? They're in the house, I can hear them in the halls...

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: Clear the house before you open that safe room. Watch the dead ends.
radio.done: Halls are clear.

radio.speaker: Minister
radio.start: The override is in the kitchen, by the door. Please hurry.
radio.done: It's open! Get me out of here!

objectives.label: Walk the minister to the helipad

radio.speaker: Minister
radio.start: Stay close to me. Please, stay close.
radio.done: Is that the chopper? Tell me that's the chopper.

objectives.label: Hold the helipad until the chopper lands

radio.speaker: Pilot
radio.start: Forty-five seconds out. Keep that pad clear!

objectives.label: Put down the Brute on the lawn

radio.speaker: Pilot
radio.start: I'm not setting down with that thing on the lawn!
radio.done: Lawn's clear. Coming in.

radio.speaker: Pilot
radio.start: On the skids. Thirty seconds!

name: Cure
description: A cure is waiting in a lab at the end of Harrow's metro line. Fight down through the station, through a stopped train and the blast door, find which lab holds it, and carry it to the evacuation pad.
briefing: The research labs at the end of the metro line say they have it: a cure. Then they stopped answering.
Down through the station, onto the platforms, and through the stopped train: the hall is blocked past it. The tunnel's power opens the blast door to the labs.
Six labs. The index terminal will say which one. Carry it to the pad on the roof yard. Eleven minutes before the city's bombed flat.
debrief: The cure's on the bird. Whatever happens now, it was worth it.

radio.speaker: Pilot
radio.start: Dropping you by the stadium. Clear the entrance and the station's yours.
radio.done: Station doors are open. No going back up after this.

objectives.label: Open the platform gates from the ticket office

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: The platform gates are run from the ticket office, west side of the hall.
radio.done: Gates are up. Down you go.

objectives.label: Through the train to the far platform

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: The hall's fallen in halfway. The way on is through the stopped train on the west track.
radio.done: You're through.

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: The tunnel's generator runs the blast door. Start it and hold while it runs up.
radio.done: Blast door's open. Labs ahead.

objectives.label: Find which lab has the cure

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: Index terminal's by the blast door. It'll say which lab.
radio.done: Lab four, east side. Its door's open now.

objectives.label: Carry the cure to the pad

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: Get it out of lab four and up to the pad. Don't drop it.
radio.done: Cure's on the pad.

objectives.label: Put down the Brute on the pad

radio.speaker: Pilot
radio.start: There's something huge on the roof yard! I can't land!
radio.done: It's down. Coming in.

radio.speaker: Pilot
radio.start: Forty-five seconds, then the bombers are over the city!

name: Hotspot
description: Three minutes in the old freight yard with the nests awake. Kill as many as you can, as fast as you can.
briefing: The old freight yard is boiling over. Three minutes: kill everything that moves.

objectives.label: Kill all you can for three minutes

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: Three minutes. Make them count.

variants.description: Three minutes at the Crossroads, the old market town, with the nests awake. Kill as many as you can, as fast as you can.
briefing: The Crossroads is boiling over. Three minutes: kill everything that moves.

variants.description: Three minutes among the container stacks with the nests awake. Kill as many as you can, as fast as you can.
briefing: The docks are boiling over. Three minutes: kill everything that moves.

variants.description: Three minutes in the botanical gardens with the nests awake. Kill as many as you can, as fast as you can.
briefing: The gardens are boiling over. Three minutes: kill everything that moves.

variants.description: Three minutes in the old town with the nests awake. Kill as many as you can, as fast as you can.
briefing: The old town is boiling over. Three minutes: kill everything that moves.

variants.description: Three minutes in the old food depot with the nests awake. Kill as many as you can, as fast as you can.
briefing: The food depot is boiling over. Three minutes: kill everything that moves.

name: Supply Run
description: Three supply crates are lying around an overrun army compound. Carry each one back to the truck in the courtyard.
briefing: An army compound outside Harrow was overrun with its stores still in it. Three crates are worth the trip.
Carry them to the truck in the courtyard. Carrying slows you down: travel light.
debrief: Crates are on the truck. Good haul.

objectives.label: Bring the crate from the barracks

radio.speaker: Quartermaster
radio.start: First crate's in the barracks, south-west.

objectives.label: Bring the crate from the shed

radio.speaker: Quartermaster
radio.start: Next one's in the vehicle shed, south-east.

objectives.label: Bring the crate from the radar hut

radio.speaker: Quartermaster
radio.start: Last one's behind the radar mast, north-east.
radio.done: That's all three.

variants.description: Three supply crates were left around the docks when the port fell. Carry each one back to the dock workers' camp by the crane.
briefing: The port was a supply depot before it fell, and three crates are still lying about.
Carry them to the dock workers' camp round the crane. Carrying slows you down: travel light.

objectives.label: Bring the crate from the north warehouse

radio.speaker: Quartermaster
radio.start: First crate's in the north warehouse.

objectives.label: Bring the crate from the gatehouse

radio.speaker: Quartermaster
radio.start: Next one's in the gatehouse, west by the road.

objectives.label: Bring the crate from the west pier

radio.speaker: Quartermaster
radio.start: Last one's out on the west pier.
radio.done: That's all three.

variants.description: Three supply crates are stashed around the old town. Carry each one back to the fountain in the square.
briefing: The town's relief stores were split up when it was overrun. Three crates are worth the trip.
Carry them to the fountain in the square. Carrying slows you down: travel light.

objectives.label: Bring the crate from the church

radio.speaker: Quartermaster
radio.start: First crate's in the church, north of the square.

objectives.label: Bring the crate from the hotel

radio.speaker: Quartermaster
radio.start: Next one's in the hotel, east of the square.

objectives.label: Bring the crate from the mill

radio.speaker: Quartermaster
radio.start: Last one's over the river, in the mill.
radio.done: That's all three.

name: Data Grab
description: Four terminals in an overrun army compound still hold their data. Pull it from every one, then get to the truck.
briefing: The compound's terminals still have the army's patrol data on them. Pull it from all four: HQ, operations, the radar hut and the vehicle shed.
debrief: Data's out. Command will put it to use.

objectives.label: Pull the data from all four terminals

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: Four terminals. Work them in any order.
radio.done: Got it all. To the truck.

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: Truck's leaving in thirty.

variants.description: Four terminals in the botanical gardens' research rooms still hold the samples data. Pull it from every one, then get to the main gate.
briefing: The gardens grew the first test crops for the cure. Four terminals still hold the data: the orangery, both ends of the nursery's glasshouse and the gazebo on the lake's island.

objectives.label: Pull the data from all four terminals

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: Four terminals. Work them in any order.
radio.done: Got it all. To the truck.

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: Truck's at the gate. Thirty seconds.

variants.description: Four terminals around the port still hold the shipping manifests. Pull the data from every one, then get to the quay.
briefing: The port's manifests show where the army's last shipments went. Pull them from all four: the harbour office, both warehouses and the camp by the crane.

objectives.label: Pull the data from all four terminals

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: Four terminals. Work them in any order.
radio.done: Got it all. To the truck.

objectives.label: Get to the boat at the west pier

radio.speaker: Command
radio.start: Boat's at the quay. Thirty seconds.

name: Shipment
description: A weapons shipment is sitting in an overrun compound's courtyard. Keep it in one piece until the convoy collects it.
briefing: A weapons shipment is on pallets in the compound courtyard and the dead are all over it. The convoy needs two and a half minutes.
debrief: Shipment's on the convoy, every crate of it.

objectives.label: Keep the shipment in one piece

radio.speaker: Convoy
radio.start: Two and a half minutes out. Don't let them tear it open!
radio.done: Convoy's here. Shipment's safe.

variants.description: A weapons shipment is sitting in the old town's square. Keep it in one piece until the convoy collects it.
briefing: A weapons shipment is on pallets in the town square and the dead are all over it. The convoy needs two and a half minutes.

objectives.label: Keep the shipment in one piece

radio.speaker: Convoy
radio.start: Two and a half minutes out. Don't let them tear it open!
radio.done: Convoy's here. Shipment's safe.

variants.description: A weapons shipment is sitting on the orangery's terrace in the botanical gardens. Keep it in one piece until the convoy collects it.
briefing: A weapons shipment is on pallets on the orangery terrace and the dead are all over it. The convoy needs two and a half minutes.

objectives.label: Keep the shipment in one piece

radio.speaker: Convoy
radio.start: Two and a half minutes out. Don't let them tear it open!
radio.done: Convoy's here. Shipment's safe.
